{{Quote|We passed through this sanctuary for scoundrels a few times and, fortunately, never ended up on the bad side of ME-8D9— an ancient protocol droid who was supposedly an assassin before she became Maz's personal enforcer.|[[R0-GR]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Droidography">''[[Star Wars: Droidography]]''</ref>}}
'''ME-8D9''', also known as '''Emmie''', was an ancient [[protocol droid]] who resided in [[Takodana Castle]] on [[Takodana]] for many [[Standard year|years]]. Once known to be an [[assassin]], the [[droid]] later served criminals as a translator. Although her origins were unknown, some believed she began her life with the [[Jedi Order]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], she broke up a fight between the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Romwell Krass Junior]] and a [[Unidentified New Republic pilot|New Republic pilot]]. Emmie was later present at the castle shortly before the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Takodana|attacked Takodana]] following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]].

==Biography==
[[File:ME8D9-SWBC6.png|thumb|left|150px|ME-8D9]]
Emmie was an ancient [[protocol droid]] who was charged with enforcing law and order at<ref name="DB" /> [[Pirate Queen|pirate queen]]<ref name="HRA1">[[The High Republic Adventures (2022) 1|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2022) 1]]</ref> [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] on [[Takodana]]. She once served as an [[assassin]] before working as a translator for criminals. Some believed that Emmie had begun her operational life working with the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="DB" /> Emmie was reputed to be much older than Maz Kanata and some believed that the [[droid]] was part of the ancient castle population.<ref name="TVD" /> Frequently reprogrammed, she remembered little of her initial functions.<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> Emmie was a free droid who had no masters but was happy to help Maz run the castle, which served as a pub and [[hotel]] for travelers.<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref>

In [[382 BBY]],<ref name="HRDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[The High Republic Adventures (2022) 1|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2022) 1]] to [[382 BBY]].</ref> Emmie worked at night as a server in Kanata's castle, and reported to the [[pirate]] that a [[starship]] she had placed on watch<ref name="HRA1" />—the ''[[Grim Devourer]]''<ref name="HRA2">[[The High Republic Adventures (2022) 2|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2022) 2]]</ref> of her criminal rivals the [[Dank Graks]]—had been spotted leaving Takodana.<ref name="HRA1" />

In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> Emmie broke up a fight between the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[agent]] [[Romwell Krass Junior]] and a [[Unidentified New Republic pilot|New Republic pilot]]. Romwell had lost [[Krass family|his family]] during a [[New Republic]] [[Attack on the Hyborean Moon|attack]] on the [[Hyborean Moon]] where he had worked at a [[Hyborean Moon black-site prison|black-site prison]]. Emmie separated the two belligerents and warned them that they had broken the Castle's law. When Romwell made a defiant remark, Emmie electrocuted him, knocking him unconscious. She then brought both to the lower levels of the castle where the two men were imprisoned in holding cells.<ref name="Life Debt" />

After Maz had dealt with Romwell and the New Republic pilot, Emmie accompanied Maz as she walked on the parapets overlooking [[Nymeve Lake]]. Emmie informed Maz that peace had returned to the Castle. Maz thanked the droid but added that peace had not returned to her heart. She sensed that something was off balance and causing the water in the lake to be turgid. She counseled Emmie that it was wise for them to be prepared. When Emmie inquired what was going on, Maz instructed her to prepare the [[Tua-Lu|''Stranger's Fortune'']] for flight because she wanted to have a look around [[the galaxy]]. Emmie complied with Maz's wishes.<ref name="Life Debt" />

[[File:Motley_crowd-TFA.png|thumb|right|350px|ME-8D9 bears witness to the Hosnian Cataclysm]]
By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="SWADate">"[[Tales from Wild Space: Win/Lose]]" features [[Takodana Castle]], which was destroyed in [[34 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> Emmie was present in the Takodana Castle for the arrival of champion [[dejarik]] player [[Bilk Plessey]]. When Plessey challenged Kanata to a game, and claimed he could outplay her with both hands tied behind his back, she had Emmie restrain him with [[Stuncuffs|binders]] normally reserved for rowdy patrons. Though Plessey was forced to input his moves to the [[hologame table]] with his snout, he was victorious, and was unbound by the droid. Later, [[cartographer]] [[Emil Graf]] shared the story with his droids [[BB-00]] and [[CR-8R]] between games of dejarik with the latter<ref name="SWA24">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=24|story=Tales from Wild Space: Win/Lose}}</ref> in 34 or [[35 ABY]].<ref name="FrameDate">{{WildSpaceDate}}</ref>

In 34 ABY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> ME-8D9 was still working at Maz Kanata's castle shortly before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. She was delighted to see [[Han Solo]] when he arrived there.<ref name="Complete Visual New">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> Later, she and the other guests witnessed a [[dark energy]] beam from the [[First Order]]'s [[superweapon]] [[Starkiller Base]] destroying the worlds of the [[Hosnian system]]. Shortly later, the castle was [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] by First Order forces searching for the droid [[BB-8]], who was carrying a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] which led to [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:ME8D9-SWCT.png|thumb|left|200px|Emmie in Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana]]
{{Quote|'Emmie' also serves as a translator for the different alien races making shady deals on site. I have a feeling that some of words she's heard can't be repeated in any language.|R0-GR|<ref name="Star Wars: Droidography" />}}
ME-8D9 was a protocol droid with a [[Gender|female]] programming. She had an exoskeleton like burnished [[bronzium]] and peaky spikes on her legs, arms, and skull. She spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard]] and a mechanical language. Emmie had two hands with five fingers. Each of these fingers was fitted with a thin golden filament which allowed her to electrocute troublesome patrons at Maz Kanata's castle.<ref name="Life Debt" /> A data storage center was shielded within her chest unit.<ref name="CharEnc" />

==Behind the scenes==
ME-8D9 was portrayed by [[Stephanie Silva]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Actor">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mandy.com/actor/profile/stephanie-silva-1#|text=Stephanie Silva, Actor, London - Mandy|archivedate=20190401194744}}</ref> She was not given a listing in the cast, but was attributed for her work as a "creature & droid performer."<ref name="TFA Credits">''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]'' credits</ref>
